props.name: appearance
props.description: Wheel vs compact appearance. Use with object `style` when you need both.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the compact trigger label from the current value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the compact trigger when no selection exists.

examples.title: Date (wheels)
examples.code:
<DateTimePicker
        label="Due date"
        mode="date"
        style="wheels"
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
      />

examples.title: Date (compact calendar)
examples.code:
<DateTimePicker
        label="Event date"
        mode="date"
        style="compact"
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
      />

examples.title: Date (inline calendar)
examples.code:
<DateTimePicker
        label="Trip date"
        mode="date"
        style="inline"
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
      />

examples.title: Time (wheels)
examples.code:
<DateTimePicker
        label="Meeting time"
        mode="time"
        style="wheels"
        minuteInterval={15}
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
      />

examples.title: Date and time (compact)
examples.code:
<DateTimePicker
        label="Appointment"
        mode="datetime"
        style="compact"
        minuteInterval={5}
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
      />

examples.title: Countdown timer
examples.code:
<DateTimePicker
        label="Timer"
        mode="countdown"
        style="wheels"
        minuteInterval={1}
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
      />
